title: Main Street, Pallaskenry, Co. Limerick, V94C5XH
seoTitle: Main Street, Pallaskenry, Co. Limerick, V94C5XH
description:
O’Mahony Property are delighted to bring to the market this beautifully presented three-bedroom mid-terrace property, ideally located on the Main Street in Pallaskenry, Co. Limerick.

This newly built property presents a fantastic opportunity to acquire a modern, turn-key home with the added benefit of being a true blank canvas for its new owner. The property is offered without flooring, allowing the purchaser the freedom to put their own stamp on the home and finish the interiors to their own taste, style and specification.

The ground floor comprises a welcoming entrance hall leading into a spacious open-plan kitchen, living and dining room. This bright and versatile space provides an excellent setting for both everyday family living and entertaining. With the flooring and furnishings left for the new owner to choose, this generous room offers an ideal opportunity to create a bespoke living space that reflects your own personality.

Also located on the ground floor is a separate utility room and convenient WC. This property also benefits from a private, fully enclosed yard, providing a secure and low-maintenance outdoor space

Upstairs, the property comprises three well-proportioned bedrooms and a main family bathroom. The accommodation offers excellent flexibility for families, first-time buyers or those requiring additional space for a home office, guest bedroom or study. 

The property's location on the Main Street is a particular highlight, with a wide range of amenities conveniently located close by. Residents can enjoy easy access to local shops, cafés, restaurants, pubs, services and community facilities, while schools, sporting facilities and recreational amenities are also within easy reach.

The property also benefits from excellent connectivity to Limerick City and the surrounding areas, making it an ideal choice for commuters. With convenient road links to Limerick and the wider county, it offers an attractive combination of town-centre living and accessibility.

This is a superb opportunity for a purchaser looking for a new build property that they can truly make their own. New owners can focus on the exciting finishing touches — selecting flooring, furnishing each room and adding their own individual style throughout.

O’Mahony Property highly recommend viewing this property to appreciate the quality, layout, potential and excellent Main Street location on offer. A blank canvas with the hard work already done, this home is ready for its new owner to put their own twist on it.
